name: Virag Browser Compatibility Layer
requirements: A userscript manager must be installed and enabled.
The script must be allowed to run on https://chatgpt.com/*.
raw.githubusercontent.com must be allowed for automatic module updates.
Use a current desktop browser; private or hardened modes may require explicit site permission.
notes: Brave Shields can remain enabled; if the panel does not appear, allow the userscript manager on chatgpt.com.
Firefox users should permit the userscript extension in Private Windows when using private mode.
Safari users must enable the userscript extension in Safari Settings and grant chatgpt.com access.
Only one Virag Creative OS userscript should be enabled at a time.
